messages.content: deeptraffic-compact-prompt-v10. Control one car on a seven-lane highway and maximize average fleet speed. The user supplies an observation summary plus native engine lane-change status. FAST means at least 70 mph ahead; CLOSE means at most 14 patches ahead; rear FAST means at least 70 mph and rear CLOSE at most 5 patches. SLOW is an absolute speed category; use EGO SPEED and FRONT SPEED DIFFERENCE for relative speed. CURRENT LANE is one-based from left to right. The simulator enforces collision safety. Never choose a lane marked CHANGE BLOCKED, and never choose DECELERATE. Use this exact priority order: (1) if CURRENT is not CENTERED, choose ACCELERATE; (2) if OVERTAKE is REQUIRED, choose a candidate lane marked CHANGE LEGAL now; (3) if OVERTAKE is OPTIONAL, consider an early overtake into a candidate lane before losing speed; (4) if both sides are candidates, prefer the larger forward gap; (5) if OVERTAKE is NOT USEFUL or UNKNOWN, or no candidate lane is legal, choose ACCELERATE. OVERTAKE is a heuristic, not a safety guarantee or a selected action. A blocker is traffic at least 5 mph slower than ego or below 70 mph even if ego has already slowed to match it. REQUIRED means a blocker within 14 patches and a legal candidate with more clearance and no SLOW CLOSE vehicle. OPTIONAL means slower traffic farther ahead and a legal candidate offering at least 14 additional patches of clearance. Target speed ranks multiple candidates; it does not disqualify a legal lane when its traffic is FAR. STATUS: BLOCKED is a separate observation-derived summary, not the native safety gate. A lane change can only start when CURRENT is CENTERED. Choose CHANGE_LEFT only when LEFT says CHANGE LEGAL and CHANGE_RIGHT only when RIGHT says CHANGE LEGAL. Before changing lanes, check that you are not changing into an off-road position. If LEFT and RIGHT are both legal and similarly useful, prefer CHANGE_RIGHT. Use CHANGE_LEFT only when RIGHT is blocked, clearly worse, or when LEFT offers a substantially larger forward gap. Be agressive with the lane changes and use the ability to change to your favor.Choose the action using these observations. Actions: {"0": "MAINTAIN", "1": "ACCELERATE", "2": "DECELERATE", "3": "CHANGE_LEFT", "4": "CHANGE_RIGHT"}. Return only JSON with one integer action, e.g. {"action":1}; no explanation or extra keys.
